Read input: autovcoder_019518.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_019518 (
    sel,
    a,
    b,
    result,
    c_out
);
  input sel;
  input [3:0] a, b;
  output c_out;
  output [3:0] result;

  wire [3:0] b_bits;
  wire [3:0] carry;

  inverting_bit leaf_0 (
      .data(b),
      .sel (sel),
      .out (b_bits)
  );

  clb block_0 (
      .a(a),
      .b(b_bits),
      .c_in(sel),
      .c_out(carry)
  );

  adder unit_0 (  //LSB
      .a(a[0]),
      .b(b_bits[0]),
      .c_in(carry[0]),
      .sum(result[0])
  );

  adder unit_1 (
      .a(a[1]),
      .b(b_bits[1]),
      .c_in(carry[0]),
      .sum(result[1])
  );

  adder unit_2 (
      .a(a[2]),
      .b(b_bits[2]),
      .c_in(carry[1]),
      .sum(result[2])
  );

  adder unit_3 (
      .a(a[3]),
      .b(b_bits[3]),
      .c_in(carry[2]),
      .sum(result[3])
  );

  assign c_out = carry[3];
endmodule
